pt.name: Adeus a Brooke Eby
pt.note: Morre aos 37 anos a tiktoker que passou quatro anos mostrando com humor a vida com ELA, e seguidores lotam os perfis de homenagens.

en.name: Goodbye, Brooke Eby
en.note: The TikToker who spent four years showing life with ALS through humor has died at 37, and followers are flooding her profiles with tributes.
